summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 (proposed — nothing changed yet)  **What I found by reading the code (no edits made):**  I traced the full watchlist path end to end and it looks correctly wired, which is worth flagging up front because it contradicts the ticket's working theory:  - `WatchlistPage.tsx` has no localStorage/sessionStorage/anonymous fallback anywhere. It always loads the active list from the server (`GET /watchlist`, picks `res.data[0].id` — not a client-cached id) and always saves via authenticated API calls. - `client/src/lib/api.ts` sends every request with `credentials: "include"`; au
